title: The Ice Fisher
text: An old woman sits on a stool by a hole in the ice, a line dropped into the black water, a lantern beside her. She has not caught anything in years, she says cheerfully, but today she might. The line is moving. Something down there is very big.

outcomes.text: She catches something with too many eyes, and gives it to you.
Something catches her line, and pulls.

options.label: The wisest asks what she is fishing for.

outcomes.text: Her husband, she says. He fell through in the war.
She waves without looking up, and calls after you to keep your feet dry. The Leader doesn't, and the cold gets in.
